reasons: Both copies of addlist (boltons/dictutils.py and the private copy in boltons/urlutils.py) now call `v = list(v)` before the truthiness check and before any traversal. Generators, iterators, ranges and other iterables are therefore materialised once and kept in yield order. An empty iterable returns early, so it does not create the key. Lists and tuples behave as before, apart from a harmless copy. FastIterOrderedMultiDict and QueryParamDict inherit the fix.
